## REVIVE: Furniture Refurbishment App

**Description:**
Revive is a mobile application designed to help users identify, repair, and refurbish used furniture. The project was inspired by the large amount of reusable furniture discarded during UCLA's move-out season and aims to make refurbishment more accessible for beginners.

**Tools & Skills:**
Figma, User Interviews, Survey Research, Wireframing

**Links:**

## AI Mock Interview Platform

**Description:**
As part of the ACM-W Tech Fellowship, I collaborated with a cross-functional team to develop an AI-powered mock interview platform. The platform allows students to input a job title and description, practice answering tailored interview questions, and receive feedback on each response. I contributed to user research, identifying pain points, and translating insights into product concepts and wireframes.

**Tools & Skills:** 
Figma, User Interviews, Product Research, Wireframing
